title: Use of lower-sodium salt substitutes: WHO guideline
funder: WHO acknowledges financial support from Resolve to Save Lives and the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare of the Government of Japan for the guideline development work, and Qingdao University for hosting a guideline group meeting.
result: If choosing to use table salt, WHO suggests replacing regular table salt with lower-sodium salt substitutes that contain potassium (conditional recommendation), for adults in general populations, not pregnant women or children, and excluding individuals with kidney impairments or other conditions that might compromise potassium excretion. The recommendation applies to discretionary table salt, not to salt in manufactured or restaurant foods, and accompanies the strong recommendation to reduce sodium intake to less than 2 g/day.
